name: Should I repair my existing trim or replace it with new finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair my existing trim or replace it with new finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but the right choice depends on the condition of the existing materials. If trim is swollen, damaged, poorly matched, or outdated, replacing it often gives a cleaner result than trying to patch around problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor scuffs and small gaps can often be repaired, but warped, damaged, or mismatched trim is usually better replaced. Replacement gives a cleaner finish when the existing work is worn or inconsistent.
